content: अलम्बुषः .²1 Vomiting. .²2 The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. .²3 Prahasta, the minister of Rāvaṇa. .²4 A demon killed by Ghaṭotkaca. .²5 A gourd (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>भोपळा</ns>); रिपुं निहत्याभिननन्द वै तदा ह्यलम्बुषं पक्वमलम्बुषं यथा <ls>Mb. 7. 109. 36</ls>. .{@-षा@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a nymph or of a class of nymphs. .²2 A kind of plant (लज्जालु; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>लाजाळू</ns>). .²3 A barrier, a line of water drawn to prevent entrance (अन्याप्रवेशार्थं दत्ता जलरेखा).
